candidates.code_hint:
COMBINATION JUMP: make a substantive, coordinated change in EACH selected direction. 交互机制: Jointly trained user-interest/item interaction or scoring mechanisms, such as gated or bilinear compatibility. Preserve the causal Transformer backbone topology, input features, history readout, loss and optimizer. No independently trained score fusion.
训练策略: Optimizer, learning rate, batch size, scheduler, dropout and weight decay. Preserve model structure, features, scoring/readout and loss definition. Keep seed 42, epoch cap 200, data splits, evaluation and GPU/CPU allocation fixed.
Only minimal shape/checkpoint/predictor consistency edits outside the chosen directions are allowed; they must not introduce another modeling or training change.
